items.title: Rashee Rice: Won't practice Wednesday
items.text:
Head coach Andy Reid said that Rice (hamstring) won't practice Wednesday, Nate Taylor of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Breece Hall: Not practicing, but could play Week 7
items.text:
Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Hall (quadriceps) won't practice Wednesday but hasn't been ruled out from playing Sunday versus the Dolphins, Al Iannazzone of Newsday reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Adonai Mitchell: Returning to practice in limited fashion
items.text:
Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Mitchell (finger) will be a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Quinshon Judkins: Could be available Week 7
items.text:
Browns head coach Todd Monken said that he's optimistic that Judkins (ankle) will be available for Sunday's game against the Titans, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.comreports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jameis Winston: Ceding starting gig to McCarthy
items.text:
Winston is in line to serve as the Giants' backup quarterback Sunday against the Texans with the team planning to move forward with J.J. McCarthy as its starter in Week 7, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
